title: 2007 AMC 8 Problem 17
statement: A mixture of \(30\) liters of paint is \(25\%\) red tint, \(30\%\) yellow tint and \(45\%\) water. Five liters of yellow tint are added to the original mixture. What is the percent of yellow tint in the new mixture?

solutions.text:
The amount of yellow tint in the original mixture is \(0.3 \times 30 = 9\) liters. Adding \(5\) liters results in a total of \(14\) liters of yellow tint.

The new mixture has a total of \(35\) liters, so the percent of yellow tint is \[ 100 \cdot \dfrac{14}{35} = 100 \cdot \dfrac{2}{5} = 40 \%. \]

Thus, C is the correct answer.
hints: Find the original number of liters of yellow tint.
After adding yellow tint, both the yellow amount and the total mixture amount change.
